algorithm: glm0414-balanced-stratified/1: normalized-text groups -> Base-recall strata (0/partial/1 by group mean) -> seeded Fisher-Yates within strata (one Random(seed) stream, strata in order 0,1,2) -> alternate dev/test starting dev -> deterministic first-improvement whole-group swaps (objective |dev_mean-test_mean|, must not worsen |dev_n-test_n|)
near_duplicate_policy: exact normalized-text groups only; semantic near-duplicates NOT grouped (CPU boundary, no embedding model); limitation recorded
historical_exposure: all questions were used in past experiments; this is a retrospective internal holdout balanced on 0414 Base performance
